quarterly_data.quarter: Amkor Technology press release: Amkor Technology Announces Phase 2 of Arizona Advanced (09-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Amkor announced phase 2 of its Arizona advanced packaging and test campus. Customer commitments have surpassed the 33,000 square meters of cleanroom capacity planned for phase 1; phase 2 is expected to add 60,000 square meters, bringing the campus to approximately 93,000 square meters of cleanroom space, and increases the project's planned investment to approximately $12 billion. The campus includes wafer bump, probe, assembly and test capabilities; phases 1 and 2 together are expected to support more than 3,500 Arizona-based employees. Phase 2 construction is anticipated to begin late 2027, with completion expected by the end of 2029. Amkor describes the campus as the first OSAT production site in the U.S. for advanced packaging in high volume (company claim). CEO Kevin Engel: the phase 'reflects the confidence our customers have placed in Amkor'.
quarterly_data.figure: phase 2 adds 60,000 sq m (campus ~93,000 sq m cleanroom, phase 1 33,000 sq m); planned investment ~$12 billion; construction late 2027 to end of 2029
